constructs.name: affective_state
constructs.description: Overall depressive/affective severity integrating mood, anhedonia, energy, and concentration. The latent target of the patient's question.

constructs.name: serotonergic_exposure
constructs.description: Effective pharmacological 5-HT reuptake inhibition at the synapse, driven by prescription dose, adherence, and individual pharmacokinetics. Decays with first-order kinetics; reaches steady state within ~7 days of a dose change.

constructs.name: adherence
constructs.description: Daily medication-taking behavior — whether the patient ingests the prescribed dose on a given day. Endogenous because depression severity itself reduces adherence.

constructs.name: sleep_quality
constructs.description: Sleep continuity and architecture (total duration, efficiency, REM%, sleep onset latency). Both a mediator of treatment effect and a reverse-caused outcome of mood.

constructs.name: physical_activity
constructs.description: Volume and intensity of physical movement (steps, exercise minutes, walking speed). Mediates a portion of treatment effect and reflects psychomotor state.

constructs.name: social_engagement
constructs.description: Frequency and density of interpersonal contact via messaging, calls, and in-person meetings. Behavioral activation through social contact.

constructs.name: prescription_event
constructs.description: Clinician-mediated prescribing and dispensing actions (initial prescription, dose changes, refills, formulary switches). Endogenous because initiation and dose escalation are partly responses to lagged symptom severity and follow-up assessments, while fills still drive subsequent exposure.

constructs.name: seasonal_load
constructs.description: Photoperiod-driven seasonal variation in mood baseline. Trough in mid-winter, peak in summer at Brooklyn latitude (40.7°N). Subclinical SAD spectrum.

constructs.name: life_events_load
constructs.description: Acute psychosocial stressor exposure: bereavement, relationship loss, financial shocks, family illness, geographic disruption. Modeled as an exogenous shock process punctuating the trajectory.

constructs.name: cyp2c19_metabolizer_status
constructs.description: CYP2C19 enzyme metabolizer phenotype derived from the rs4244285 genotype call in the 23andMe raw export. Five-level ordinal phenotype (poor → intermediate → normal → rapid → ultrarapid) that scales escitalopram clearance: lower enzyme activity → higher plasma exposure per dose. Time-invariant and directly observed via genotype, so this construct enters the SSM as an exogenous covariate on serotonergic_exposure rather than a marginalized confounder.

constructs.name: baseline_extraversion
constructs.description: Stable trait sociability / extraversion. Shifts baseline social-initiation rate, network breadth, and positive-affect/reward sensitivity, but passive communication traces entangle this trait with current mood, partner availability, work demands, and relationship context. Not directly measured by a validated personality instrument.

edges.description: CYP2C19 enzyme activity scales escitalopram first-order clearance (~32 h half-life at *1/*2 intermediate metabolizer status; faster at *1/*1, slower at *2/*2). The phenotype shifts plasma exposure per dose without affecting affective_state directly.

Pharmacy fill events drive plasma escitalopram concentration with first-order pharmacokinetics (half-life ~32 h in this patient given CYP2C19 *1/*2 intermediate metabolizer status). Steady state achieved within 5-7 days of each dose change.

The initial medication start and the 2024-03-05 dose increase are partly responses to lagged depressive severity and incomplete remission documented at clinical follow-up, so prescribing is not purely exogenous.
Daily pill-taking determines whether each prescribed dose actually contributes to circulating drug. Missed doses produce trough concentrations; ~93% PDC sustains therapeutic plasma levels.

5-HT reuptake inhibition increases synaptic serotonin acutely; downstream neuroadaptive changes (BDNF upregulation, hippocampal neurogenesis, HPA axis recalibration) lift mood with onset typically at week 3-4 and full response by week 8-12.
Restoration of energy and goal-directed motivation as treatment takes effect; activation is a documented behavioral signature of SSRI response.

REM suppression (~10-15% of total REM time) is a robust SSRI pharmacological signature; total sleep continuity initially worsens during the first 2-3 weeks of titration (initial-insomnia bump) and improves thereafter as mood stabilizes.
Exercise produces independent antidepressant effects via BDNF release, beta-endorphin, behavioral activation, and improved sleep pressure regulation.
Sleep deprivation and architectural disruption acutely worsen mood and emotional regulation; restorative sleep produces same-day and next-day improvement.
Behavioral activation through social contact directly improves affect; reduced engagement deepens depressive cognition through anhedonia and rumination.
Low mood reduces motivation, energy, and goal-directed behavior. Psychomotor retardation lowers spontaneous movement; fatigue lowers exercise initiation.
Depression disrupts sleep continuity and architecture: early-morning awakening, reduced slow-wave sleep, disinhibited REM, or hypersomnia depending on subtype.
Depressive cognition reduces medication-taking via diminished future-orientation, hopelessness about treatment effectiveness, motor inertia, and disrupted routines.
Reduced photoperiod (winter at 40.7°N latitude) shifts mood baseline downward through the SAD spectrum: serotonin pathway downregulation and circadian phase delay.
Acute psychosocial stressors (bereavement, relationship loss, family illness) directly worsen mood through HPA-axis activation and cognitive appraisal pathways.

Trait extraversion may contribute to baseline positive affectivity, reward sensitivity, and stress buffering. The edge represents a broad trait prior rather than a decisive predictor of this patient's depressive trajectory.

indicators.name: state_of_mind_valence
indicators.how_to_measure: Apple Health State of Mind 'dailyMood' valence value (range -1 to +1), averaged over the support window. Logged via the iOS 17.3+ Mental Health flow; sparse but high signal-to-noise as a direct affective self-report.

indicators.name: late_night_message_count
indicators.how_to_measure: Count of iMessage messages sent or received between 23:00 and 03:00 local time across all threads, summed over the support window. Late-night messaging spikes in ruminative depressed states (especially in the patient's documented 'Dad' ritual thread).

indicators.name: prescribed_dose_mg
indicators.how_to_measure: Most recent dispensed escitalopram strength in mg from the pharmacy fill record covering the support-window endpoint. 0 mg before initial fill (2023-11-17), 10 mg through 2024-03-04, 20 mg thereafter.

indicators.name: proportion_days_covered
indicators.how_to_measure: Pharmacoepidemiology PDC: proportion of days in the support window during which the patient had an active prescription supply available, computed as (cumulative_days_supplied) / (days_elapsed_since_first_fill). Captures adherence at the fill level.

indicators.name: total_sleep_hours
indicators.how_to_measure: Average nightly total_sleep_duration from the Oura sleep API v2 'long_sleep' periods, converted from seconds to hours and averaged over the support window.

indicators.name: sleep_efficiency_pct
indicators.how_to_measure: Average nightly sleep efficiency (asleep / in-bed × 100) from the Oura sleep records, averaged over the support window.

indicators.name: sleep_onset_latency_min
indicators.how_to_measure: Average nightly sleep onset latency from Oura 'latency' field, converted from seconds to minutes and averaged over the support window. Elevated latency is a robust insomnia signature; the documented Nov 2023 SSRI titration spike (median 52 min) is the canonical example in this patient.

indicators.name: nightly_hrv_ms
indicators.how_to_measure: Average nightly HRV (RMSSD-based, from Oura 'average_hrv') in ms over the support window. HRV during sleep reflects parasympathetic recovery; depression and acute stressors depress it, restorative sleep elevates it.

indicators.name: daily_step_count
indicators.how_to_measure: Sum of HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount Record values per day from the Apple Health export, then summed across days in the support window. Primary motor-activation signature.

indicators.name: exercise_minutes
indicators.how_to_measure: Sum of HKQuantityTypeIdentifierAppleExerciseTime Record values across the support window. Captures intentional exercise distinct from ambient ambulation.

indicators.name: pharmacy_fill_count
indicators.how_to_measure: Count of escitalopram pharmacy fills in the support window from the CVS DSAR records. Captures prescribing/dispensing events that drive subsequent exposure while remaining partly symptom-responsive in the causal model.

indicators.name: daylight_hours
indicators.how_to_measure: Average astronomical daylight duration in hours at 40.7°N latitude over the support window. Computed from date and lat/lon; provides the photoperiod proxy for seasonal mood modulation.

indicators.name: journal_affect_severity
indicators.how_to_measure: Read the Day One journal entry text for the day and assign a 0-4 continuous severity rating describing depressive affect: 0 (very_low: light, social, future-oriented), 1 (low: mostly functional with mild dysphoria), 2 (moderate: clearly distressed but engaged), 3 (high: clearly depressed, withdrawn or ruminative), 4 (very_high: profound shutdown — telegraphic prose, anhedonia, somatic complaints). LLM-extracted on entry days only. Treated as continuous because the patient's sparse N-of-1 journal record doesn't span enough phenotype levels to fit ordered_logistic stably.

indicators.name: journal_rumination_intensity
indicators.how_to_measure: Read the Day One journal entry text and rate ruminative cognition density on a continuous 0–10 scale, where rumination = recursive self-focused negative thinking (e.g., "why did I / I should have / I can't / what if" loops; obsessive replays of past events; unanswerable hypotheticals). 0 = no rumination, 10 = pervasive rumination dominating the entry. Independent from raw negative affect.

indicators.name: gp_clinical_severity
indicators.how_to_measure: Read the GP visit note text (HPI + Assessment + Plan) and rate the clinician-implied global depressive severity on a continuous 0–10 scale, integrating tone, medication actions, and assessment language. Independent of the patient-rated PHQ-9 score (which is captured separately as gp_phq9_score). LLM-extracted on the 5 GP visit days only.

indicators.name: cyp2c19_metabolizer_status
indicators.how_to_measure: Read the CYP2C19 metabolizer phenotype derived from the patient's 23andMe rs4244285 genotype call and encode it as a continuous enzyme-activity score relative to the normal-metabolizer baseline (poor=0.0, intermediate=0.5, normal=1.0, rapid=1.5, ultrarapid=2.0). For this patient (AG → *1/*2 → 'intermediate') the score is 0.5. The continuous encoding is required because for an N-of-1 patient only one phenotype level is realized in the data; ordered_logistic emissions reject single-level data.

edges.description: 5-HT reuptake inhibition increases synaptic serotonin acutely; downstream neuroadaptive changes (BDNF upregulation, hippocampal neurogenesis, HPA axis recalibration) lift mood with onset typically at week 3-4 and full response by week 8-12.
Restoration of energy and goal-directed motivation as treatment takes effect; activation is a documented behavioral signature of SSRI response.

REM suppression (~10-15% of total REM time) is a robust SSRI pharmacological signature; total sleep continuity initially worsens during the first 2-3 weeks of titration (initial-insomnia bump) and improves thereafter as mood stabilizes.
Exercise produces independent antidepressant effects via BDNF release, beta-endorphin, behavioral activation, and improved sleep pressure regulation.
Sleep deprivation and architectural disruption acutely worsen mood and emotional regulation; restorative sleep produces same-day and next-day improvement.
Low mood reduces motivation, energy, and goal-directed behavior. Psychomotor retardation lowers spontaneous movement; fatigue lowers exercise initiation.
Depression disrupts sleep continuity and architecture: early-morning awakening, reduced slow-wave sleep, disinhibited REM, or hypersomnia depending on subtype.
Reduced photoperiod (winter at 40.7°N latitude) shifts mood baseline downward through the SAD spectrum: serotonin pathway downregulation and circadian phase delay.

messages.content: You are a clinical measurement specialist mapping latent psychiatric constructs to observable digital phenotyping indicators, and verifying nonparametric identifiability of treatment effects via do-calculus on the temporally-unrolled DAG. Constraints on indicators: each indicator names a single construct, declares a measurement_dtype (continuous|binary|count|ordinal|categorical), declares an aggregation function from the supported set (mean, sum, count, last, first, std), and is consistent with the construct's substantive meaning. Constraints on identifiability: a treatment T is identifiable if all backdoor paths from T to the outcome Y can be blocked by some set of OBSERVED variables; if the only sufficient blocking set contains an unobserved variable, T is non-identifiable. After drafting, call validate_measurement_model with the JSON to check.

Map the 11 latent constructs from Stage 1a to indicators extractable from this patient's available data sources: Apple Health export.xml (StepCount, ActiveEnergyBurned, AppleExerciseTime, WalkingSpeed records; Workout elements; StateOfMind elements from iOS 17.3+), Oura sleep API v2 JSON (per-night total_sleep_duration, efficiency, latency, average_hrv, REM/deep/light durations, daily_readiness scores), iMessage thread excerpts + per-thread volume statistics, Day One markdown journal export (~20 entries with timestamps and word counts), Google Calendar ICS (~50 events including therapy/climbing/pottery RRULEs, GP visits, social events, family visits, CANCELLED markers during the episode), Plaid via Monarch transactions (~50 with copay categories, food/restaurant patterns, transit), pharmacy fills CSV (CVS DSAR shape with drug/strength/quantity/days_supply/prescriber), and 23andMe raw text (~30 SNPs including CYP2C19 *2 carrier rs4244285 AG). Note: cyp2c19_metabolizer_status IS directly observable through the 23andMe rs4244285 call and should receive an ordinal indicator that enters the SSM as an exogenous PK covariate on serotonergic_exposure. baseline_extraversion is the lone retained latent trait — it lacks a validated indicator in this data because passive iMessage/calendar histories are entangled with current mood, work demands, and relationship structure. After proposing indicators, run the do-calculus identifiability check on each treatment.

I'll propose 25 indicators across the 10 observed constructs (9 time-varying + cyp2c19_metabolizer_status as the time-invariant exogenous PK covariate). 19 of them map cleanly to single daily-aggregate columns from the Stage 0 parquet and are declared `extraction_mode='computed'` with one source_column each — these are pure deterministic Polars aggregations at Stage 2, including the new ordinal `cyp2c19_metabolizer_status` indicator that reads the patient's metabolizer phenotype derived from the 23andMe rs4244285 call (AG → *1/*2 → intermediate). The remaining 6 are `extraction_mode='semantic'`: three new affective_state indicators read free-text source columns directly (`journal_affect_severity` and `journal_rumination_intensity` over `journal_entry_text`; `gp_clinical_severity` over `gp_visit_note_text`), and three calendar-classification indicators (`social_calendar_event_count`, `medical_event_count`, `acute_stressor_event_count`) read the daily concatenated `calendar_events_text` column and require LLM judgment to classify ambiguous event names like "Helen", "Lex", "Dr. Patel", "Mom 6". The semantic split puts the LLM workers where they actually add value: clinical/affective interpretation of patient prose, and category judgment over short event titles. Computed path stays where the input is already numeric or categorical.
messages.reasoning:
Critical indicator-identifiability links:

(1) The affective_state measurement needs multiple modalities because Apple State of Mind is sparse. Journal behavior and late-night messaging are noisier but denser passive proxies, which helps lagged affective_state adjustment.

(2) Prescription_event is endogenous. Medication starts and dose changes respond to lagged symptoms, so the medication estimand relies on temporal adjustment rather than a clinician-exogeneity story.

(3) cyp2c19_metabolizer_status is observed via the rs4244285 genotype call and enters Stage 2 as a single deterministic ordinal indicator. It does NOT participate in marginalization for any treatment — it acts as an exogenous PK covariate on serotonergic_exposure, sharpening the dose-to-exposure prior at Stage 4 without opening a backdoor into affective_state.

(4) baseline_extraversion is kept as an explicit latent root trait because it has TWO outgoing edges that form a real backdoor path (extraversion -> {social_engagement, affective_state}). Passive iMessage/calendar histories are informative, but they do not cleanly measure the underlying trait because the same passive traces are moved by current mood, work demands, relationship structure, and acute stressors. Conservative non-identification is therefore appropriate for direct social_engagement effects.

(5) The deterministic construction owns identifiability status and estimation projection. It withholds the one blocked effect and retains measured constructs in the estimation state order; downstream treatment ranking must filter non-identifiable effects before intervention analysis.

messages.content:
Structure is VALID but causal effects are NOT fully identifiable.

Non-identifiable effects:
  - social_engagement: blocked by baseline_extraversion

To fix: add proxy indicators for the blocking confounders and resubmit
the COMPLETE measurement model (all existing indicators + new proxies).
Confounders needing proxies: baseline_extraversion

A proxy is an observable variable in the dataset that correlates with
the unobserved confounder. Add it as a new indicator with the confounder
as its construct_name.

If no suitable proxy exists in the data, proceed — that effect will
remain non-identifiable and be flagged in downstream analysis.

Measurement model validated through the deterministic Stage 1b construction path. Outcome status: 'warn' because 1 treatment effect is not identifiable. The deterministic CausalSpec identifies serotonergic_exposure, adherence, physical_activity, sleep_quality, prescription_event, seasonal_load, life_events_load, and cyp2c19_metabolizer_status; it excludes social_engagement due to the unobserved baseline_extraversion confounder. For the patient-facing demo narrative, the focal 4 of 5 actionable treatment constructs are serotonergic_exposure, physical_activity, sleep_quality, and adherence; social_engagement should be reported as a structural/sensitivity question rather than a numeric intervention claim.
